nom: Mario Badescu Glycolic Grapefruit Cleansing Lotion

avis.texte: I am 28 and I have combination skin, it burned pretty badly and left my sling feeling irritated,itchy and changed the texture of my skin. I would recommend testing before buying.
Very harsh on my skin. I normally use the glycolic acid toner which works great. The grapefruit lotion literally left me with chemical burns on my face and neck.

I have post damage to my earlier acne, stressed past over exposure to the sun. This is a great product for my own skincare needs to address the issues that I have dealt with in the past. I recommend a sunscreen for the day when using this product. I am also a fan of the alpha grapefruit toner for the day, my evening gentle exfoliation is really wonderful, the vit c in the morning routine with the alpha grapefruit after cleansing with the seaweed soap which has a slight granular exfoliation from the seaweed really leaves my skin incredibly smooth, bright, feeling great, especially when I use a vit c serum or moisturizer, also recommend the buttermilk moisturizer for a bright, moisturized texture The whole line is highly recommended. The price is great especially for the results that can be achieved

avis.titre: Have Used Other MB Toners - This Is My Fave!
avis.texte: Love Mario Badescu products and this is my most recent try. Fell in love! I deal with acne, dry skin, and wrinkles...this product has noticibly helped clear my skin. Will purchase again!
This cleansing lotion is so refreshing and not harsh at all like some other toners. This toner wakes your skin right up and is the prefect addition to your skincare routine.

This is my fav toner. Tingles on application, and can sting slightly when it comes in contact with a blemish. Helps shrink my pores and clear out my skin. Also has a pleasant scent that isn't overpowering.

avis.titre: My summer toner - great for combo oily skin
avis.texte: This is my summer toner for when I get more oily. Works well as a part of a 3-part regimen (cleanser, this toner, and moisturizer). It doesn't dry me out in summer. (I use a different one in winter when I tend to get drier.) I love that you can mix and match MB products in how it works best for you. If you're not sure where to start, visit Ulta in person and ask. That's how I've chosen all my MB products. The associates are always knowledgeable and helpful.

avis.titre: Might have finally found my holy grail
avis.texte: I don't normally take the time to write reviews but this was too good not to. Lately I've had a lot of acne/bumps on my forehead. I was using another Mario toner in my routine but NOTHING was getting rid of them. Within a few days of using this instead, there's noticeably less bumps and the redness of the ones that remain has all but disappeared. And my face feels so soft! It does tingle a little but just follow with a moisturizer and you'll be good.

My skin remained red throughout the entirety of the use of the product. I understand that glycolic acid is an acid and breaks down the skin so it can grow new cells to look more youthful, but I disliked the constant redness.
Sales lady at ulta recommended this to me. I love it! My skin feels nice and clean after I take all my makeup off.

avis.titre: Almost took it back, so glad I didn't
avis.texte: I use this after the cleansing gel as a toner more or less. I almost took it back bc it burned the first few uses, but my skin got used to it and now I never get breakouts. And I'm not the best at washing my face twice everyday. I love the skin care line, it takes a bit of trial and error to figure out what works best for you, but I finally found something that works for me.

I'm in my 40s. My skin had become dull, dry and sometimes almost scaly. I had used a $400 skincare system and moved away from it because the cost seemed crazy. My skin conditions plummeted. I did an online search seeing if there existed a more economical alternative to the system I had used. Sure enough, this popped up as the recommended toner. I bought it. I'm almost through my first bottle which lasted me 3 months - morning and night. It could likely last longer but I went cotton pad crazy. I've just received my second bottle. Using this in conjunction with a deep pore cleanser. I use this after the cleanser. Within a few days, the scaliness and dullness was lessening. My skin practically shines right now. Makeup goes on smoother, I feel ok going to the store makeup-free on weekends. On occasion it does tingle when I put it on, especially in dry weather, but I birthed two kids - I can (and have!) survive(d) a skin tingle. This stuff is AMAZING. I highly recommend and I literally pray my skin never becomes immune to it. Also don't be confused - this is a TONER to be used after a cleanser, NOT a cleanser as the name suggests.
Burned when applying. Made me break out after every use. Too strong for someone with sensitive skin.

My skin had been EXTREMELY oily and always so congested and broken out since the 7th grade (I'm now a junior in college) and I hadn't been able to go without makeup since then because I was always so embarrassed! I had tried other Mario products and they helped, just didn't quite clear my skin up. Over the summer, I decided to try this toner with the Botanical Facial Cleanser and the Enzyme Cleanser (whichever was on hand I love them both) with this toner. My skin has not been this clear since before I ever started breaking out!!! I can finally feel comfortable going with out makeup!! Highly reccommend!

I needed a toner with a kick. I have combo skin, historically problematic breakouts and large pores. This stuff WORKS. I've been using about two weeks and there's a noticeable difference in the smoothness of my skin - no dry patches, no oil. Those with crazy skin know that while those two features seem competing, they are absolutely not. My skin is soft, clarified, and I feel the appearance of my pores are slightly smaller. My makeup goes on my smoothly.

I originally went to Ulta to purchase the original Glycolic Acid Toner but it was out of stock. After the Ulta employee recommended this product saying they are virtually the same, I believed her. THIS IS NOT THE SAME!! It is so strong, has a terrible smell, and burnt! I returned the next day. It also is FULL of alcohol

I've only been using this for 4 days and every time it burns my skin. I have combo skin, I never had acne and I rarely break out. I really wanted to like it bc afterwards my skin would feel really smooth.

My skin usually never gets irritated with nothing but THIS sis 😭 this really burns my skin. I have combo skin I NEVER had acne and I rarely get a pimple so I think I must be allergic to the glycolic acid in this 🤷🏻‍♀️ I really wanted to love it 😩 Bc it does leave my skin feeling soft afterwards but the burning is too much when I apply it.

I've been using this every night for over a month (cleanse, wipe this on like a toner, then serum & moisturizer) and it's probably the best skin care product I've ever used. I have normal to dry skin that gets very dry, dull and flakey in the winter. Since using this I have not had a single flake of dry skin and it has a healthy glow. Serum and moisturizer absorb like a dream after. It's gentle (just don't put on broken skin), light clean scent (but does not smell like grapefruit) and the flip top cap is easy to use and get just the right amount of product on your cotton pad. Will be repurchasing this over and over. Thank you Mario Badescu for creating awesome products, I love everything I've tried from this line.

I'm 20 and have combo/oily skin. I'll get dry in my cheek bone areas and under my bottom lip as to where my T-Zone will get super oily as well as my under eye/cheek area. I also have noticeable pores and wrinkles in my oily areas. Right now I'm breaking out so bad on my forehead, so when I apply this on my face after my Glycolic Foaming cleanser, it burns only in the areas where I'm breaking out. But like it says, not recommended for acne erupted skin. So I use it everywhere except my forehead and I wake up to a plump and youthful looking face. Obviously my pores and wrinkles haven't disappeared but this just makes my face look so baby like and it gives it this clarified clean look. I love this product! Can't wait for my acne to clear out on my forehead so I can finally get the real deal.

avis.titre: Wanted to like it but didn't
avis.texte: I was so excited about trying this between the glycolic acid and the grapefruit for my oily skin. One use and I returned it due to the horrible smell. I can usually get past a not-so-pleasant smell if I like a product but this one was so strong it made me want to throw up and it didn't go away quickly. Their products are usually awesome but they totally missed it on the fragrance for this one.

I use this twice a day after my cleanser and before my toner. I don't really get the "lotion" part of the product and the astringency of the product isn't very much. Regardless, this has really helped reduce the blackheads on my pesky oil field of a nose.

Let me first say that I have tried multiple toners out there that have either created an overflow of oil production or have dried my skin out completely. For the first time, this toner doesn't do either of those things! It is moisturizing for my oily skin, doesn't break out, able to use it every day with no issues of dry skin. I have used it for several weeks and have seen an improvement in my skin so it is definetly worth while!

avis.titre: Very potent glycolic and great for several skin issues!
avis.texte: This is one of the best glycolic products for daily to weekly use. I would compare it to Epicuran's 10% glycolic acid toner. If you have very oily skin you might be able to use this daily without it drying your skin out. If you're combination like myself you'd be better off using this every other night or every two nights. It does hydrate since it contains aloe vera. This stuff will give you a great exfoliation if your skin is dull with lots of build up. When you use this with a cotton pad you will see dead skin on the pad. It's not necessarily dirt. If you have acneic and oily skin this will help to clear it up since acneic skin is prone to retention hyperkeratosis which contributes to the acne, and desperately needs the exfoliation. If your skin is dry I would consider using MB's glycolic acid toner which contains no alcohol.

I use this morning and night. I am on my 2nd bottle. My skin has never looked so good. Cleared up my skin and shrunk my pores. I get compliments on how good my skin looks. It is a little drying on the face so maybe use once a day. And it does burn at first but for the results I'm seeing I'll deal with that. Happy customer.

avis.titre: I am continuing to use this product.
avis.texte: I have not used the product long enough to make a judgement about its effectiveness.
This product broke me out with huge red bumps with white heads on the sides of my face after the first use.

avis.titre: Very good product- but read and heed the warnings
avis.texte: Don't use this if you have sensitive skin. It will burn like crazy. My skin is pretty tough and it stung the first time I used it. Also, heed the warnings about sun exposure. Great product, just use it wisely :)
I have been using this for almost a year and I absolutely love it. It keeps my skin clear and pores looking great.

Bought this because i thought it would be great for clearing brightening and smoothing to fine lines. I dont feel like it even cleaned or toned my skin at all. I ended up returning and getting my trusty special c cleansing lotion instead

avis.titre: Don't buy if you have sensitive skin
avis.texte: I would simply put some on a cotton ball and gently wipe my face and it made it burn. I would not but this again but I do recommend the aloe one. I dont have sensitive skin.

This is the only product I've ever reviewed, but that's just because this is the only thing that has actually worked for me. I'm 20 and was blessed with acne when I was just 9 years old (as you can tell, genetics are not my friend) and I have tried every product you can imagine. I spent so much money trying pretty much every acne regimen out there when all along I just needed this little magic bottle and a $5 moisturizer from Trader Joe's? I wish I had known about this 10 years ago. Anyway, here is my experience with this product: A few months ago, my skin was probably the worst it's ever been. My skin was greasy, my pores were visibly clogged despite taking great care of it (thanks for nothing, skin), I had clusters of acne scars and spots on my cheeks, and my cheeks and forehead were covered in these tiny little bumps I later learned were called comedones (pretty much just blackheads trapped under the skin). I tried so many different creams, masks, and toners in an attempt to clean out my congested pores and fade my scars, but nothing worked. Eventually after digging around the Ulta website I came across this product and it's honestly the best thing that's ever happened to my skincare routine. Within a few weeks my skin was smooth (the comedones are completely GONE), less oily (this toner is a bit drying but if you apply a moisturizer after you should be fine), and my acne scars have faded drastically. Now my skincare regimen only includes Biore face wash with charcoal, thi
Love it, it just takes a few uses to get used to it. But it has improved my overall skin texture and feel.
While thius product works wonders on my oily and acne prone skin, it could damge those who are sensitive. It is a harsh product, but that is why i love it.

I've used MB products for years. But the one product I've always stayed with no matter what else I've tried is MB Glycolic Acid and Grapefruit Glycolic Acid. I find the latter to cleanse the skin well and close or shrink pores. I do not use water on my face, I cleanse with MB Rice Milk Cleanser and then with a cotton pad, wipe away anything left behind with the grapefruit cleanser. After that I apply my moisturizer routine. I have no breakouts and very few skin issues. Been doing this for years. Seems to work for me. The last thing I want to do is remove any natural moisture in my skin- hence no water.

Hi. I am 42 and get hormonal cystic acne. I am waiting for my spironolactone to start working so I came across this MB product online. I used it last night- a patch test first on my jawline and no reaction so I proceeded to my forehead and no reaction. It is a high PH acidic toner which by today is really kicking my cystic acne into control. It is going to take some time but anything is an improvement. Plus I used their Whitening mask this morning for acne scars and that was extra brightening with kojic acid and licorice. I think when You ( like myself) are schlepping back and forth to the dermatologist taking every drug known to man and then you find these MB products it's a breath of fresh air! :) Oh and I bought the control moisturizer for oily skin too and and it felt really good going on. It wasn't too heavy. And it looks matte. I think the stuff they sell at your local store (salicylic acid products) do nothing but irritate. MB products soothe and help your face to heal. Like I said also if you're taking heavy retinoids you can take this toner, well my skin is on Tazorac 0.5% alternating with Tazorac 0.1%. I've been on Retin-A most of my adult life so this toner is small potatoes for me as far as stinging. For you who have super sensitive skin and take retina-A you might want to just try their Glycolic toner or the Grapefruit toner. I heard someone say this toner made their skin oily. No way. That would only happen if you didn't moisturize and put some zinc sunscreen on
Use twice daily. Has greatly improved skin texture and cleanliness.

avis.titre: So far this product has definitely helped brighten my skin
avis.texte: I use it at night to help fade dark acne scars and fine lines. It has helped to brighten my skin over all and it hasn't caused any burns or irritation. I've only used it for a week, however, it seems to be helping my skin purge, possibly because it's removing dead skin cells. My only con is that it would be nice to know exactly how much glycolic acid is in the product especially for those who are using additional acne treatments.

I bought this because I wanted to try something stronger than the glycolic toner. Well, it's definitely stronger. It brightens up the skin, and leaves it really clean. I use it with my other MB products ( vit c oil, glycolic renewal skin cream). My face is not sensitive, and I don't have acne so it works great for me. Since it's strong I use it 3 times/week in the evening.

I was originally using the MB Glycolic Toner but when I went to my local Ulta to restock, they were sold out so I tried this instead. I love it! It is a little strong than the glycolic toner so my skin did need some time to adjust. My dark spots are fading faster and this really takes care of the dry flakiness from using retinol.

avis.titre: So far so good, lines are less visible, adult breakouts poof
avis.texte: Use after washing face, the. Moisturizer. Once in morning once at night

avis.titre: It is not life changing but good formula!
avis.texte: It is a light weight Lotion-Toner product. I really like that it is really gentle on my skin and doesn't smell funky. Also you can't beat the price for big bottle! I am definetly going to try other products from Same line!

I bought this looking for a cheaper alternative to Pixi's Glow Tonic toner without realizing that this has alcohol in it while Pixi does not. The first few uses it really stung my face but now its minimal, but I do feel as if its drying my face out a bit. Definitely something I would not purchase again.

Really hated this. I tried to give it time, too, because I know face products can take a few weeks to be effective. I have oily skin and large pores. This burned and made my skin dry. Even though it made my skin dry, it never seemed to absorb into my skin - like it floated on top, all sticky and greasy. Returned it, bought Clinique's pily skin line again, and saw an immediate difference.

I do not have sensitive skin and I rarely break out. I was looking for a toner to improve my skin tone and gave this a shot, but I was very disappointed. After two weeks of use, my skin has a dozen small bumps and is extremely irritated. I follow with moisturizer after every use but it does little good.

avis.titre: It has cleared up my acne so quickly! And my skin is soft!
avis.texte: I use this as my toner after using the peter Thomas roath Irish mud cleanser and I follow up with the buffer lotion from Mario and then some dermalogica and ptr moisturizing products.

avis.titre: Pleasant burn. Might be strong for some
avis.texte: Will finish to see how my skin is after using the whole bottle.

It does do a good job of deep cleaning my pores and somewhat tightens them and that is two things that I like about it. I have a combination of oily and dry skin and I tell you what, one swipe around the face is good enough. wiping my face with this product on a pad can be face stinging and drying. I believe this product is best use for anybody with oily skin because this product will irritate and sting anybody with sensitive and dry skin. The irritation can last for the rest of day followed by the dry skin effect for days if used alone and not followed by with a face moisturizer. I don't recommend this product for people with prone acne because it can possible worsen the acne for first time user. I broke out a couple acne on the first day of use due to the stinging and drying effect. After couple days of usage my face had adjusted to the chemical, but even after applying a moisturizer after each swipe, my face still has the drying effect feeling and it's been several days now.

avis.titre: A must in your skin routine!
avis.texte: I use this product after cleansing and pat drying my face. Afterwards I put my treatments and serums. It does sting if you have acne but this is a game changer.

blistered my skin! The first couple of times I used this I enjoyed it,it didn't burn or aggravate my skin but by the third time it caused little painful water blisters to pop up on my cheeks and chin. Will not be using this on my face anymore. I read that it helps with little bumps on the arms or "chicken skin" so I'm going to try it for that so it doesn't go to waste.

I love this product, my skin has changed alot in the last few years and I have had to find new products to accommodate my changing needs. I have been experiencing alot of adult acne from improper exfoliation. This is the fix. Mario Badescu has something for everyone, no matter what your issues. This product has helped clear up my skin.

Love the tingling feeling from this product. Noticed more even skin tone without any irritation, which I normally get around my mouth and nose, but no problems with this product. Been using for about 1 month
I use it as a toner. It is a little stronger than the plain grapefruit toner. I like it.

I do not have sensitive skin and usually use a scrub to exfoliate my skin. I wanted to try a chemical exfoliator and found this in the ulta store. I've given it 2 tries with the same result. Each use made parts of my face feel like rubbing alcohol on an open cut. I have no cuts or acne. Even 30 min after using and moisturizing, my face feels burnt and sensitive. I have normal skin, not oily or dry, but after using this my skin had a horrible shine to it as well.

I have used other cleansing lotions from this line before and liked them like the grapefruit one. This one was way too harsh for me. I had to return. It may have just been to harsh for me and may work well for other folks. I have large pores and congestion but it doesn't erupt often. My skin is combo. Sometimes too shiny with small breakouts. After this my skin was dry and flaking and red and irritated.

I bought this because I have oily acne prone skin and acne scars and this helped remove excess oil as well as dirt and makeup along with clearing up my dark spots! It lasts a long time too. Definitely repurchasing :)

avis.titre: I would never buy this product again!
avis.texte: When I purchased the item, I told the salesclerk that I needed something that would not make my skin oily. This item was oily and I did not like it!

I love Mario Badescue the first time I tried their samples. I bought this one by accident because I mean to buy the cucumber toner but it does just as good as the cucumber one. Unlike other toners, Mario Badescue toners isn't harsh on the skin, no stinging or drying effect. I have oily but sensetive skin, and this works to remove my oiliness yet doesn't dry out my skin.

I bought this product in conjunction with the Enzyme Cleansing gel (in love). However, this toner is extremely harsh on the skin. I have very oily skin in the T-Zone but normal skin on the perimeter of my face. I have mild acne and very clogged pores due to my oil production and acne scars (because I pop my pimples). I used this product after handwashing (no tools) and had an immediate stinging sensation. I tried to attribute it to it "working" but too often we equate stinging and tingling with working but it is actually your skin telling you to STOP! CEASE! DESIST! I tried to use it again the next day but it started to burn my skin, I had to immediately wash it off with cool water. My chin and skin around my nose was raw and red . I tried to moisturize it because it was super dry, but because of the trauma even my mild organic coconut oil moisturizer burned. I returned this product immediately. Still looking for the "right" toner. I purchased Origins Zero-Oil no burning and it has controlled my oil throughout the day. We will see.
This leaves my face feeling so clean and refreshed!! I've been using it for over a year now!

I have been a Mario Badescu fan for years! As an esthetician, this is one of the only products that I will pay full price for because it is worth it! I have tried tons of other high-end, expensive product lines that either don't deliver, are way too harsh, or are too difficult to use. I like something I can use on a regular basis that gives me results....and this is it. I have oily, breakout prone skin and the dry desert climate I live in doesn't help. I use this glycolic toner to keep my skin fresh and exfoliated, because let's face it, no one is getting younger. It is also fantastic for keeping my acne under control. I use it every night after cleansing and follow it with a good moisturizer. When I am feeling a little too dried out, I switch to every other night or I just spot treat. Every time I have tried to switch to something new, I regret it. This toner always gets me back on track. For stubborn breakouts, I follow up with Mario's pink Drying Lotion. I recommend this to all of my clients with problem skin or those who just want a gentle yet effective anti-aging product. The best part is that one bottle will last a very long time and it is quite affordable compared to other clinical facial product lines. Bonus tip: use it on your bikini line for those stubborn ingrowns!
This product is Amazing ! My skin has never been so clean my acne is starting to diminish before my eyes ! It's amazing I wish it didn't sting as much but beauty is pain ladies!

I am not one to review beauty products because I buy so many of them and am rarely impressed. But this toner is absolutely amazing. I have naturally good skin with few issues but since turning 40 I have a few wrinkles on my forehead, the 11 lines that I cannot stand. Also I have some annoying dry patches on my forehead above my eyebrows and side of nose. After using this toner for 2 weeks, the dry patches are totally gone and the forehead wrinkles are less prominent. Must be the glycolic acid. I am so impressed. My pores are smaller too and my skin looks radiant I bought the Mario Badescu anti aging starter kit today. I am excited to see how the other products work. I highly recommend this stuff. I should mention I have VERY oily skin so maybe that is why I can use this toner twice a day without drying out my skin like others have said it does.
I used it everyday and it caused irritation. Maybe better for weekly use
Been using this for two years. It really helps the yellow tones in my face fade. I love it. It also does not dry my skin out.
This is great but only if u have super oily skin,can cause irritation

I use this cleansing lotion to help dry/disenfect my pimples, as well as help clear old acne scars, and exfoliate my skin. Of course since I have sensitive skin, I can only use this toner about 1-2 times a week; even if you don't have sensitive skin, this should probably be limited to 2-3 times a week considering how strong glycolic acid is. But other than that, I use this stuff religiously. It's awesome for toning the skin, exfolating, and helping get rid of acne/acne scars/dark spots.
I like to use this product at night after I have washed my face and before I put on moisturizer. I feel really clean!
I've used this product for the past 3 years, and it has done amazoig things to my face incluiding clearing my acne. 100 % reccommenf this product to anyone.
After seven days, my brown spots started fading process. Doesn't dry my skin.

Love the product line. This cleansing lotion is very effective in controlling breakouts, even hormonal breakouts. I have found it best to use in the morning before makeup and at night before you go to sleep.

My skin has always been very oily and I've dealt with breakouts since puberty. Now that I'm 30 I want a product that can help erase signs of past breakouts and I think this is going to work great. I noticed my skin tone looked more even just after a couple uses (Yay!!!) and it had a tightening effect on my pores. I did notice a slight sting in the first application, but it went away pretty quickly, plus I use a moisturizer afterwards. So yes I'd recommend it to a friend as long as they don't have a sensitive skin type.

I was very disappointed in this product. It was very harsh on my combination skin and worked well at first but my skin began to go back to the way it used to be in about a month. I was very disgusted after reading the ingredients that a "Prestige" brand would use rubbing alcohol (went by another name) as one of their ingredients. That breaks skin barriers down and may kill bacteria but by taking that barrier, it also comes back faster. I returned it after noticing that.

I have very oily skin with large pores. My skin has developed a rougher texture now that I'm in my 30s and I have closed comedones (tiny whiteheads that don't go away like acne) near my eyes. I've been using this toner for 2 weeks and noticed my skin looks much clearer and it's slowly starting to dissolve the comedones. I experienced a little bit of itching when I first applied it, but that went away quickly. I definitely didn't experience the burning that other reviewers have mentioned.

I bought this product for my oily T-zone. As soon as I applied the product all over my face it started to burn and I immediately broke out in hives all over my face, neck and ears. Unless you have extreme acne or extreme oil all over you face, do not buy this product. It's been almost a week since I've used this product and my hives still haven't subsided and the texture of my skin is still flaky and rough.

This product is much too harsh for my combination / oily skin. I used this product for two weeks only in my t-zone and only at night. When I first applied it, I felt a stinging sensation. This stinging was not the pleasant "this is working" kind of sensation, but more of an "ouch, my skin is about to burn and fall off" sensation. I thought that maybe I was being a baby and continued give it a chance, but my skin never grew to tolerate it. I did notice my skin quality marginally improve while using this product, but I do not feel that the small benefits were worth the potential harm to my skin in the long term.
